description: Write dated journal entries, search them, and keep them saved in your browser.

faqs.a: Entries are stored in your browser's localStorage on this device. They never leave your computer — there is no server involved.
The search box matches text in the entry title and body. Entries are sorted newest-first.
The date picker defaults to today. Click any date in the entry list to load it for editing.
faqs.q: How do I edit an old entry?

faqs.a: Use your browser's export to save entries, or clear them with the delete button. Back up anything important elsewhere.
faqs.q: Can I export or delete entries?

howto: The date picker defaults to today — change it to write for another day.
Give the entry a title, write your thoughts, and click Save Entry.
Search past entries with the search box; click an entry to load it for editing.
Delete an entry you no longer want with the Delete button.
title: Daily Journal
